boundaries: the rendered messages page at phone and desktop widths

notes: Mobile messages list. Two passes, two findings, both from rendering the real page with real-length content. The fix and the findings are covered by a new E2E spec.

instruments.evidence: a53e0cf2b: the conversation list panel is w-full when isMobile, w-[20rem] on desktop (was w-[20rem] flex-shrink-0 at every width since b93cbb7f1). Boundary: the rendered page at phone and desktop widths.
Read 587693fe2's ledger line (Send button at phone widths, cf1edd9dc) and the B6 history: phone layouts were measured in a real browser before.

Rendered the page (Playwright, mocked signed-in user, two conversations, one with a 50-character name, a folder). The row menu button had no accessible name: a screen reader heard three dots. Finding conversation-row-menu-unnamed.
The label key messages.conversationOptions.ariaLabel exists in en.json (i18n:check OK).
Conversation fields the row reads (other_user.username, is_archived, archived_at) match models/conversation.go.
The title rule existed twice (row and chat header); both now use conversationTitle.
Username length is 3..50 (services/auth.go:422), so the test name is the real maximum.
The 50-character maximum username.
The chat header title already had min-w-0 and truncate; the row did not.
Title rule duplicated in the row and the header, merged into conversationTitle (the header keeps 'unknown' for no selection).
Other titles in MessagesPage: the chat header h3 is truncated; the mod mail and group titles go through the same helper and row.
Controls built on tests/e2e/messages-layout.spec.ts ('long name'): truncation reverted -> 'Expected <= 313, Received 419'; label removed -> the button cannot be found, 1 failed. Both pass at HEAD.
The new spec runs in CI E2E (testDir ./tests).
tsc -b 0, eslint and prettier clean, i18n:check OK.
Found by B2 and B6; already rows.
Each control makes it fail.

Measured at 360, 375, 390 and 1280: rows 359/374/389 px and 320 px on desktop, document never wider than the viewport, no control past the right edge, the chat view full width on phones. The 50-character name ran under the row menu button (the name had no truncate, its flex parent no min-w-0). Finding conversation-row-long-name-overlaps-menu. A first render showed ARCHIVED on an active row: the mock omitted archived_at, which the server always sends (explicit null), so not a defect.
Playwright counts read: 4 passed in the new spec; 12 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing) with messaging and navigation.
The user reported the messages page broken on mobile; the list now fills the screen.
The 2 vitest files that import MessagesPage: 21 passed, 1 skipped.

Ran messaging and navigation E2E: messaging.spec.ts:26 failed once with parallel workers (10 s URL wait); with CI settings it passes at HEAD twice and at base, and all 12 pass together. Environmental, not this change.
No existing control patches MessagesPage.tsx, en.json or the new spec at the changed lines.
The real page in a real browser.

instruments.why: n/a: Playwright has no shuffle, and each test opens its own page with its own routes.
